TS010 no-pass-in-except

A handler that does nothing hides the failure it caught.

languages: python
severity: error
default: on
group: stable
go: Go has no exception handler, so there is no empty one to catch
javascript: JavaScript has no pass statement; an empty catch is reported by TS028
odin: Odin has no exception handler, so there is no empty one to catch
rust: Rust has no exception handler, so there is no empty one to catch
typescript: TypeScript has no pass statement; an empty catch is reported by TS028
zig: Zig has no exception handler, so there is no empty one to catch

TigerStyle: "All errors must be handled. [...] Specifically, we found that almost all (92%) of the catastrophic system failures are the result of incorrect handling of non-fatal errors explicitly signaled in software."
